metadata.description: BistroMathWorks plugin marketplace — thinking tools for stress-testing plans, decisions, code, and real estate deals.

plugins.name: bistromath-thinking-tools
plugins.description: BistroMath Thinking Tools — adversarial plan grilling (grill-me and grill-with-docs, written by Matt Pocock and repackaged here with full credit — a great idea worth bundling), guided ideation (ideation-partner), Munger-style inversion for business decisions (never-lose) and code (munger), Doolittle, the deal-side copilot for real estate agents, and project-md-creator, which writes and trims CLAUDE.md files down to what Claude would get wrong without them.

plugins.name: bistromath-realestate-tools
plugins.description: BistroMath Real Estate Tools — 9 skills for working agents: comps and pricing (comp-crusher), listing marketing (listing-arsenal), open houses (open-house-machine), sphere nurture (sphere-engine), prospecting (prospector) — written by Miron Briley/CyclSales (MIT) and repackaged with full credit — plus BistroMathWorks originals: newsletter-analyzer, presentation-strategist, offer-extractor for mortgage client emails, and cre-search for one-prompt commercial property search across Crexi, LoopNet, and PropertyDrive.

plugins.name: idea-queue
plugins.description: Idea queue mod for Claude Code: jot ideas while Claude works and each goes in at the right moment — build-on ideas after the turn, busy work when Claude sits idle (broader work plans first), new concepts when you press Send. Side pane with hotkeys, /idea, Auto/Paused switch, color-coded queue, optional herdr popup and status pill.
